Name: Naamah
Summary: Naamah was the daughter of Lamech and Zillah, and the sister of Tubal-cain.
KeyStory: Naamah is named at the end of Cain's genealogy, the last person recorded in that line.
RelatedPeople: Lamech, Son of Methusael; Zillah; Tubal-cain
LifeLesson: God names women in genealogies where the world might forget them.
